$comment: 현재 주차 중 — today's rows whose inot_status is IN: vehicles the barrier has admitted and not yet released. This is a DIFFERENT question from the registration counts, which is why it earns its own value: those say how many are expected, this says how many are here. OUT is excluded even though it is in const.ACTIVE_STATUSES — a departed car is still a valid uncancelled registration, and is exactly what must not be counted as present. The vendor performs the RESERVE→IN→OUT transition itself, so this is reported, not inferred. **IT IS UP TO TEN MINUTES STALE**: iParking offers no webhook or push, so the only way to see an arrival is the poll (const.POLL_INTERVAL_S, 600 s since v0.3.1), and a visit shorter than one interval may never appear at all. That limit is why there is no arrival Flow trigger — see iparking_lib/visitcar/device.py.
